say:3:1310228001:0.text: Come on, stop hesitating! Let's just go today!
say:3:1310228001:0.source_cn: 喂，别犹豫了，咱们干脆今天就出发吧！

say:4:1310228002:0.text: But we still have to prepare food and equipment for the adventure. And it's best to make plans before going into the swamps...
say:4:1310228002:0.source_cn: 可是，我们还得准备探险时的食物和工具呢，而且去沼泽最好...

say:5:1310228003:0.text: Padrick, the tales of the lost have been around for years. There's no need to rush. We can go after the festival. Let's have fun today, alright?
say:5:1310228003:0.source_cn: 帕特里克，迷路怪谈持续了那么多年了，不用着急，祭典结束...

say:9:1310228004:0.text: "Adventure"? Ooh, that sounds so exciting! Where are you going? I've never been on an adventure before...
say:9:1310228004:0.source_cn: “探险”？你们要去哪里探险？听起来很有意思！我还从来没...

say:10:1310228005:0.text: Princess! Your Highness, we wanna go to the Whispering Fen to uncover the mystery behind the tales of the lost. People have been haunted by it for decades!
say:10:1310228005:0.source_cn: 是公主殿下！殿下，我们想要去安息沼泽，去揭开笼罩在人们...

say:11:1310228006:0.text: How thrilling! I'm tempted to join. I've never been to that area either.
say:11:1310228006:0.source_cn: 哇，好刺激，听起来真的很有趣！我都有点心动了，我也没有...

say:15:1310228008:0.text: Stop, stop, stop, Rodrigo! I know exactly what you're going to say... Don't worry, I'm not going to run off. I still have friends to entertain!
say:15:1310228008:0.source_cn: 停停停，我知道你想说什么……好啦，我不会乱跑的，我还要...

say:18:1310228009:0.text: These are your friends, Your Highness? Are they here for the Snowspire Festival? Don't tell me they're royalty from far away?!
say:18:1310228009:0.source_cn: 这几位是公主殿下的朋友？是来参加冬日祭典的吗？

say:21:1310228010:0.text: It's our first time at a festival where everyone comes together to have fun like this! And haha, well, we're not royalty, but you should be honored to be in Sir Chippy's presence!
say:21:1310228010:0.source_cn: 对呀，我们还是第一次参加这种所有人都聚在一起玩乐的祭典呢！

say:23:1310228011:0.text: Well then, you've gotta try all the activities. Whether it's building snowmen, ice skating, or a good old-fashioned snowball fight, all our visitors love them. You'll have a great time, I promise!
say:23:1310228011:0.source_cn: 那么，几位客人一定要好好体验一下祭典的活动。不管是堆雪...

say:26:1310228012:0.text: Yeah! I was just about to have a snowball fight with them. Do you all wanna join?
say:26:1310228012:0.source_cn: 没错，我正要带他们去打雪仗呢，你们几个要不要一起来？

say:27:1310228013:0.text: That would make four on each side, perfect for a snowball fight tournament! And Rodrigo, you can't interfere!
say:27:1310228013:0.source_cn: 我们双方各有四个人，正好可以来一场雪球大战！罗德里戈，...

say:30:1310228014:0.text:
The princess is inviting us to a snowball fight? What an honor!
Hey, who knows... we might even win!
say:30:1310228014:0.source_cn: 公主殿下邀请我们一起去打雪仗？这可是我们的荣幸！\n说...

say:31:1310228015:0.text: Perfect! The more, the merrier! That's what makes the festival so much fun!
say:31:1310228015:0.source_cn: 太棒了，一起玩的人越多、越热闹，祭典才越有趣嘛！<ke...

say:0:1310229001:0.text: That was amazing! I can't believe I just had a snowball fight with the princess!
say:0:1310229001:0.source_cn: 你们可真厉害！雪球扔得又准又快。

say:1:1310229002:0.text: Just because I'm royalty doesn't mean I can't have fun!
say:1:1310229002:0.source_cn: 那当然了，我的准头可是很不错的！

say:2:1310230001:0.text: What an incredible snowball fight! You all did an amazing job. Here, take a petal!
say:2:1310230001:0.source_cn: 哇哦，一场精彩的“雪仗”！你们表现非常出色！来，给你们...

say:5:1310230002:0.text: Wow! Maybe you'll be the one to light the fire this year!
say:5:1310230002:0.source_cn: 太好了，说不定今年为雕像点火的就是你们呢！
